Title: MemorySmith.Agent — IntentManager: Pipeline, GoalRequest Hierarchy & Command Parsing
Content:
## Overview

`IntentManager` (`Agent.Planning/IntentManager.cs`) is the bridge between `IChatInterpreter` (which produces `IntentDraft`) and `GoalFactory` (which creates `IGoal` instances). It is the central component enforcing PRINCIPLE-1 (parsers never create goals).

```
IntentDraft → IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest → GoalRequest → GoalFactory.CreateAsync → IGoal
```

## Pipeline

1. `LlmChatInterpreter.ParseDecision` deserializes the LLM's JSON response into an `IntentDraft`
2. `IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest(IntentDraft)` maps the semantic intent to a typed `GoalRequest`
3. `GoalFactory.CreateAsync(GoalRequest.GoalName, GoalRequest.Parameters)` creates the concrete `IGoal`

## GoalRequest Hierarchy (Sprint 39 P3)

Abstract base record with typed subclasses:

```csharp
public abstract record GoalRequest(string GoalName)
{
    public abstract IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? Parameters { get; }
}
```

| Subclass | Constructor | GoalName Pattern | Parameters |
|----------|-------------|-----------------|------------|
| `GatherGoalRequest` | `(string Item, int Count = 10)` | `GatherItem:{Item}` | `{ count }` |
| `CraftGoalRequest` | `(string Item, int Count = 1)` | `CraftItem:{Item}` | `{ count }` |
| `BuildGoalRequest` | `(string Blueprint, BuildOrigin? Origin = null)` | `Build:{Blueprint}` | `{ originX, originY, originZ }` or null |
| `NavigateGoalRequest` | `(int X, int Y, int Z)` | `MoveTo` | `{ x, y, z }` |
| `SmeltGoalRequest` | `(string InputItem, int Count = 1)` | `SmeltItem:{InputItem}` | `{ count }` |
| `PlaceGoalRequest` | `(string Item, int Count = 1, int? X = null, int? Y = null, int? Z = null)` | `PlaceBlock:{Item}` | `{ count, x?, y?, z? }` |

## BuildGoalRequest Mapping Table

| `IntentDraft.Intent` | Map To | Conditions | Notes |
|---------------------|--------|------------|-------|
| `gather` | `GatherGoalRequest(item, count ?? 10)` | Item required | Alias resolution via `ResolveItem()` |
| `place` | `PlaceGoalRequest(item, count ?? 1, x?, y?, z?)` | Item required; coords optional | Sprint 54; null coords = place in front |
| `craft` | `CraftGoalRequest(item, count ?? 1)` | Item required | Alias resolution via `ResolveItem()` |
| `build` | `BuildGoalRequest(blueprint, origin?)` | Blueprint required | Via `TryBuildGoal()`; alias resolution via `ResolveBlueprint()` |
| `navigate` | `NavigateGoalRequest(x, y, z)` | All 3 coords required | Returns null if coords missing (secondary path) |
| `smelt` | `SmeltGoalRequest(item, count ?? 1)` | Item required | Sprint 44 TSK-0079; separated from craft |
| `cancel` | null | — | Fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `status` | null | — | Fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `help` | null | — | Fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `conversation` / `clarify` / `ignore` | null | — | No goal produced |

## Alias Resolution

### `ResolveItem(string item)`
- Checks `AliasRegistry.ItemAliases` for canonical Minecraft ID mappings
- Examples: `"wool"` → `"white_wool"`, `"planks"` → `"oak_planks"`
- Returns item as-is if no alias exists

### `ResolveBlueprint(string? blueprint)`
- Checks `AliasRegistry.BlueprintAliases` for common name → canonical blueprint ID
- Examples: `"house"` → `"small-house"`, `"wall"` → `"stone-wall"`
- Returns null for null input

## ParseCommandString (TSK-0205)

Parses simple command strings from `IntentDraft.NextSteps` for multi-step chaining. Regex-driven with named capture groups:

| Pattern | Regex | Maps To |
|---------|-------|---------|
| `craft N item` / `craft item` | `^craft\s+(?:(?<count>\d+)\s+)?(?<item>.+)$` | `CraftGoalRequest(item, count ?? 1)` |
| `gather/mine/get N item` | `^(?:gather|mine|get)\s+(?:(?<count>\d+)\s+)?(?<item>.+)$` | `GatherGoalRequest(item, count ?? 10)` |
| `build [a] blueprint` | `^build\s+(?:a\s+)?(?<blueprint>.+)$` | `BuildGoalRequest(blueprint, null)` |
| `place N item [at X Y Z]` | `^place\s+(?:(?<count>\d+)\s+)?(?<item>.+?)(?:\s+at\s+(?<x>-?\d+)\s+(?<y>-?\d+)\s+(?<z>-?\d+))?$` | `PlaceGoalRequest(item, count, x?, y?, z?)` |
| `move/go/navigate/walk to X Y Z` | `^(?:move|go|navigate|walk)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?<x>-?\d+)\s+(?<y>-?\d+)\s+(?<z>-?\d+)` | `NavigateGoalRequest(x, y, z)` |
| `smelt N item` / `smelt item` | `^smelt\s+(?:(?<count>\d+)\s+)?(?<item>.+)$` | `SmeltGoalRequest(item, count ?? 1)` |

Returns null for unrecognized commands.
